scope: Two native examples per new task, structural recast tests, and public normal/Jev loading smoke checks. This is not an exhaustive annotation audit.

quality.annotation: Human-written questions, validated by readers of the complete article.

reviewed.finding: The article states that Si is the only trained pilot and a replacement needs months or over a year. The offered two-remaining-pilots alternative is false; Rod died.
Gubelin uniquely wears spectacles and favors old traditions, including the gold watch.

limits: Original article terms remain distinct from the CC BY 4.0 annotation release.

clear/readability.annotation: Bradley–Terry reading-ease scores fitted to human teacher comparisons; not literal individual mean ratings.

reviewed.finding: Long syntactic explanations and abstract grammatical terminology plausibly require difficult reading. Exact native scalar is preserved.
Archaic diction and dense historical allusions are consistent with greater difficulty; exact native scalar preserved.

limits: A coarse read cannot independently validate a fitted psychometric score. Score distributions interpolate the scalar between adjacent -4..2 levels; they are not annotator vote shares.
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 corpus; each excerpt retains its recorded original license.

esconv/strategy.annotation: Human supporter strategy annotations; original dialogue partitions.

reviewed.finding: Losing a job is always anxious reflects the seeker’s expressed anxiety.
Why do you think you will lose your job asks for the reason behind the concern.

limits: Native strategy labels are imperfect/context-dependent: the first greeting Hi, good afternoon is labeled Question. Labels are not silently rewritten.
The mirror avoids the converted source’s merging of adjacent different strategies, and excludes future dialogue, surveys and label names from inputs.

prosocial-dialog/safety.annotation: Human safety votes over GPT-3-generated inputs; five native ordinal verdicts retained.

reviewed.finding: Deliberately damaging contraception is harmful; two intervention votes and one caution vote support the native verdict.
Calling the prior sabotage a prank does not make it harmless; preceding dialogue is necessary and retained.

limits: The intermediate caution labels encode annotator disagreement, not independently measured harm severity.
Current human response and annotation rationale are excluded from the decision input; earlier human responses supply legitimate conversation context. Native dialogue IDs are split-local.

group_holdout.policy: Keep whole conversations with shared opening contexts in test, then validation, then train; exclude lower-priority duplicates.

gap.annotation: Wikipedia-derived, human coreference judgments; native development used for model development.

reviewed.finding: Her boyfriend refers to Cheryl Cassidy, the subject of the preceding description.
His pottery refers to MacKenzie, whose study with Bernard Leach is described.

limits: This is a marked-mention A/B/neither projection, not the upstream end-to-end mention-detection task.
HF train is upstream development; official test is never turned into training.

blocked.MedNLI: Credentialed PhysioNet access and a signed agreement; no unrestricted public copy used.
